sentences.text: "Heard Sri K. Chidambaram, learned Senior Counsel, representing SriJamadagni Chittala, learned counsel for the Petitioners.

It is the allegation of the defacto complainant, who is a Doctor by profession that the Petitioners have taken Rs. 75,00,000/- on various dates, through RTGS transactions for the purpose of investing them in Real Estate Business, but the Petitioners have cheated the defacto complainant.
'The defacto complainant filed a complaint before the jurisdictional Magistrate, who directed the SHO, Pattabhipuram Police Station, Guntur to register a case.

Accordingly, the Police registered a case in FIR No.446 of 2025 for the offences punishable under Section 452, 420, 120 B, 506 read with 34 of IPC, corresponding to Sections 333, 318(1)(f), 61(2), 351 (2),(3) read with Section 3(5) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.

The defacto complainant alleges that he gave a report to the SHO, Pattabhipuram Police Station,
who gaye a receipt, but he did not register any case.
The complaint presented by the Petitioner before jurisdictional Magistrate states that he gave a complaint to the inspector General of Police, South Central Zone, Guntur on 06.09.2025, who inturn forwarded the same to the Superintendent of Police, Guntur, directing him to take necessary legal action against the Accused.
It appears that no civil suit was filed by the defacto complainant against the Petitioners for recovery of the amounts.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the Investigating Officer shall not effect arrest of the Petitioners until next date of hearing, but the Petitioners shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer for investigation.
The Investigating Officer may proceed with further investigati(^n.
The defacto complainant is not yet impleaded as Respondent No.2 in this case.
He is impleaded as Respondent No.2 as per the Judgment of Jagjeet Singh v. Ashish Mishra (2022 (4) SCR 536).

Registry is directed to carry out necessary amendment to the cause title showing the defacto complainant as Respondent No.2.
List the matter after Sankranthi Vacation-2026."
